lines.text: Where are they right now? And what are they really doing on that phone?
Endless scrolling. Arguments at dinner. And that quiet worry you never say out loud.
There has to be a better way. Meet lookatu. The child safety app that gives you peace of mind.
Set screen time limits that actually stick. When the time is up, the phone knows.
Choose which apps are okay. Allow the good ones. Block the rest.
And when it really matters, see where they are. Location, only when you need it.
Because kids deserve some freedom, and parents deserve some calm.
Works on Android and on iPhone.
lookatu. Look out for them. Download it today.
